description: Content-Security-Policy header is missing. This leaves the app open to XSS attacks.
X-Frame-Options is missing. The page may be vulnerable to clickjacking.
X-Content-Type-Options not set. Browsers may MIME-sniff responses incorrectly.
HSTS header missing. HTTPS is not enforced, enabling downgrade attacks.
Referrer-Policy not set. Sensitive URL parameters may leak to third parties.
Permissions-Policy missing. Browser features (camera, mic) are not restricted.
